newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile industrial output up 5.1 pct in May - trade.
newsitem.headline: Chile industrial output up 5.1 pct in May - trade.

text.p: Industrial production in Chile rose 5.1 percent in May over the same month last year, but sales in the manufacturing sector dipped 1.6 percent, the trade group Sociedad de Fomento Fabril (Sofofa) reported.
The May figures brought the rise in industrial production in the first five months of the year to two percent, said Sofofa, Chile's main business organization.
The May decrease in sales was primarily a correction in rises in previous months, with sales in the first five months of the year up a cumulative 3.1 percent, said Sofofa.

Glass manufacturing showed the largest increase in production so far this year, up 39 percent over the first five months of 1996, followed by domestic appliances, up 34 percent, and metallic articles, up 28 percent, said Sofofa.
The sharpest decline in the first five months of the year was in leather shoe products, off 18 percent, said Sofofa. ((-- Rodrigo Martinez, Santiago newsroom +56-2-699-5595 x211))
